name: Capital One Venture Rewards Credit Card

emergencyMedical.notes: No emergency medical or evacuation benefit. This card has very limited travel insurance compared to Venture X.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Secondary coverage — file with personal auto insurance first. Venture X has primary coverage; regular Venture has secondary only.

rewards.travelRate: 5x miles on hotels and rental cars booked via Capital One Travel

pointValue.transferPartners: varies (1:1 to most partners, same as Venture X)

travelPerks: 5x miles on hotels and rentals via Capital One Travel
$100 Global Entry / TSA PreCheck credit every 4 years
1:1 point transfer to 15+ airline and hotel partners
bestFor: Occasional travelers who want flat-rate rewards on all spending without a premium fee — best entry point to Capital One miles ecosystem
